VISION / GENERATION / EFFICIENCY
01 / A little about me

I am a first-year Ph.D. student in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering (CSE) at the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), advised by Prof. Jiaya Jia. I am also fortunate to be co-supervised by Prof. Li Jiang.

Previously, I received my master’s degree from Tongji University and my bachelor’s degree from Beijing Jiaotong University.
